title: Online-Only and Home-Based FFLs: What ATF Files Show | FFL Intel
h1: Online-only FFLs: what the licensee files can and cannot tell you
description: There is no official ATF count of online-only or home-based FFLs. The public listing is a license file, not a business-model file. Here's what it shows.

hero.alt: Graphic of the columns on ATF's July 2026 FFL file; no field flags online-only or home-based. 77,485 licenses.

faqs.q: How many home-based FFLs are there?
faqs.a: There's no official count. ATF's public listing has no field that flags a licensee as home-based. We won't build one from address guesses. The official figures are license counts by type and state, from a named month's ATF file. See how many FFLs are there.

faqs.q: How many online-only FFLs are there?
faqs.a: There's no official count. The same file has no field that flags a licensee as online-only. A Type 01 license at a given address isn't a statement about how that licensee sells.

faqs.q: What can the official file tell you?
faqs.a: For a named month, how many licenses were listed, of what type, and the information ATF publishes for each one. It can't tell you who made a sale that month, who sells only online, or who works from a home.
